decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established modular lighting offer in a growing industry, and with no visible sign of underperformance against aspirations, management would likely keep it while using available organisational slack to let the product prove itself.

Because this ceiling luminaire also fits existing capabilities, channels, and the firm’s broad portfolio strategy, a behavioral-theory view suggests it would be retained unless clearer evidence emerges that its results fall materially below aspiration levels.
